g.title: OX111SharedSceneCore
g.text: OX-111 | SHARED SCENE CORE + URBAN PARK DATA INSCRIPTION

g.title: cluster_inputs
g.text: APP-OWNED TYPED SCENE INPUTS

g.title: cluster_core
g.text: SHARED :scene-core GRADLE LIBRARY | app depends on core; core has no app/theme dependency

g.title: cluster_outputs
g.text: SCENE OUTPUTS AND SLICE BOUNDARIES

g.title: forecast
g.text: Typed forecast projection
The selected forecast instant remains authoritative

g.title: mapping
g.text: App maps forecast + selected theme
to a theme-neutral SceneDescription
No provider DTO crosses into rendering

g.title: order
g.text: Depth-ordered scene contract
Theme supplies ordered planes and element declarations
Core draws declared content back to front

g.title: park_definition
g.text: Urban Park scene definition
Three image planes, tower face geometry,
surface material, and Park-only elements

g.title: planes
g.text: Reusable plane compositor
Optional Background / Middleground / Foreground stack
Apply one declared fit/crop transform to the plane set

g.title: painted
g.text: Reusable painted-data surface renderer
Measure and wrap the full value; apply theme surface transform,
face clip, pigment texture, and lighting

g.title: other_definitions
g.text: Built-in and future code-backed themes
City, roadside, desert, alien, and others supply
their own assets, geometry, materials, and elements

g.title: elements
g.text: Shared element pipeline
Common forecast-driven elements use typed inputs
Theme-specific painters can occupy declared passes

g.title: extensions
g.text: Future birds, signs, monuments, and other theme-specific elements
remain declared by their owning theme; this slice adds no new motif

g.title: park_scene
g.text: Urban Park uses the shared core
SKY_UNDERLAY → BACKGROUND → STARS → SUN/MOON → CLOUDS
→ MIDDLEGROUND tower → LOCATION_PAINT → FOREGROUND → PRECIPITATION

g.title: city_scenes
g.text: Other current theme scenes use the same shared contracts
Their existing appearance, weather mapping, and special elements remain intact

g.title: inscription
g.text: Chicago: one line on the tower
San Francisco: wraps to fit the same face
Selection change updates the same painter; blank value paints nothing

g.title: preserve
g.text: Keep location accessibility text and picker; all other readout values,
selected-time/timeline behavior, source-time meaning, and data viewer remain
